depth_compare_intro: Save the current depth and recoil as A. Then change a setting: the manikin is current B, and the saved marker shows A at the same point in the cycle. Matching curves overlap.
depth_compare_key: In 3D: A is the violet square; B is the amber dot. On the graph: A is dashed; B is solid.
depth_compare_same_peak: Peak depth matches. Inspect the peak, then the release: do both settings return to the resting line?
depth_compare_different_peak: Peak depths differ. Inspect both the deepest point and the release to see what changed.
depth_compare_reading: At {phase}% of the cycle: A is {a} cm depressed; B is {b} cm depressed.
depth_compare_pause: Select a still position to compare exact model heights.
depth_compare_empty: No A is saved for this age. Save your settings or start the recoil comparison.
depth_compare_scope: A stores depth and recoil for one age. Both markers use the current cycle position and animation rate.
depth_compare_graph_note: The dashed curve shows your saved A. The manikin and the values above show current B.
